title: Overdue Receivables Analysis
summary: This note details an instance where the San Jose office faced a serious cash flow issue due to significant overdue invoices. The owner segmented the data, identified the new construction line of business as disproportionately high, and used qualitative interviews to uncover root causes. Based on this combined data, three solutions were presented to leadership, resulting in a 15% drop in AR.

key_points.text: $7 million in invoices that were unpaid & significantly overdue, which represented 33% of total AR
New construction line of business accounted for 55% of the overdue AR
PM’s were not getting notified when invoices were sent out
Regional collectors were spread too thin
Liens were not being filed strategically

differences: The percentage of overdue AR mentioned is 33% in the Amazon prep, 34% in the Tanium prep, and 34% in the Tiktok prep.
